items.note: "for just me" and "There are no accounts or login."
Says it's an MVP, the thinnest working slice, with no tests. The "running today" timing isn't stated outright, but the MVP scope covers the intent.
"local web app that runs in the browser", run with the Vite dev server.
"Use React + Vite with TypeScript (I prefer TypeScript)".
"store all data in the browser's localStorage" and "the data stays on this machine".
"Track multiple habits. I can add a habit by name."
"Daily check-off. I can mark each habit done or not done for today."
Dark mode by default is never mentioned. The prompt leaves look and feel entirely to the receiver, so dark mode isn't guaranteed.

invented: The folder name `habit-tracker` inside the current working directory. The user only said "New folder" and gave no name.
